- Time: \(O(N log N (K + 1))\)
- Memory: \(O(N (K + 1))\)

N is the number of pixels of the extended image. Each band needs one FFT at its own size. The finest level holds K + 1 bands at full size, so the pyramid has about 4 (K + 1) / 3 + 2 times as many values as the image.
